tests.title: Homepage loads key navigation elements
steps: Open the homepage URL
Wait for the main page content to render
Observe the global header and top navigation
tests.expectedResult: The homepage loads successfully and the primary navigation is visible.

tests.title: Homepage highlights major shopping entry points
steps: Open the homepage URL
Scan the first visible content blocks
Inspect category or promotional entry points
tests.expectedResult: At least one prominent category or promotional navigation path is visible and clickable.

tests.title: Homepage supports basic browsing transition
steps: Open the homepage URL
Click a visible category or collection link
Observe the destination page
tests.expectedResult: The selected link opens a browseable listing or collection page without errors.

tests.title: Category page loads product listing content
steps: Open the category page URL
Wait for the listing content to render
Inspect the visible product grid or list area
tests.expectedResult: The category page loads successfully and product listing content is visible.

tests.title: Category page supports product discovery controls
steps: Open the category page URL
Inspect for sorting, filtering, or breadcrumb controls
Interact with one available browsing control if present
tests.expectedResult: Browsing controls are visible and at least one control responds without breaking the page.

tests.title: Category page allows navigation to a product detail page
steps: Open the category page URL
Click a visible product card or image
Observe the destination page
tests.expectedResult: Clicking a product listing opens a product detail page or an equivalent product experience.
